title: Meet Python
summary: Run your first program, learn how Python reads your code line by line, and meet your first error messages.
outcomes: Explain what a program is and how Python runs it, one line at a time
Display text and numbers with print()
Use Python as a calculator and know the order it works things out in
Leave comments that explain your code to people
Read an error message and fix the mistake it points to

lessons.title: Your first program
lessons.summary: Run Python, print text and learn what strings are.

lessons.title: Python as a calculator
lessons.summary: Do arithmetic with Python's operators and learn the order it works things out in.

lessons.title: Comments and how Python reads code
lessons.summary: Watch Python run a program line by line, leave comments, and control how print() ends a line.

lessons.title: Reading error messages
lessons.summary: Meet the five most common errors, read a message from the bottom up, and fix bugs calmly.

gameSummary: Program a rover with Python commands. The order of your lines decides everything.
